# For scripts/check-contract.py. referencing ships with jsonschema; it is pinned
# too because the script imports it directly. rfc3339-validator makes jsonschema
# assert the date-time format (without it the format is silently skipped), and
# six is its only dependency.

referencing==0.37.0
rfc3339-validator==0.1.4
six==1.17.0
